game_title: Refactor Rescue – Salt Flat Crossing Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Salt Flat Crossing, a blinding salt flat: the scarab scholar must handle vultures while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Salt Flat Crossing: a blinding salt flat
core_gameplay_loop: In Salt Flat Crossing, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the temple door using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The temple door reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the temple door is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 1 (intro tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Refactor Rescue' (Week 9 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Salt Flat Crossing'. region.name: Sand Dunes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against vultures in Salt Flat Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The temple door reached with actions_used <= 10.
